person.persName: السيوطي ابو الفضل عبد الرحمان بن ابي بكر بن محمد جلال الدين الخضيري الشافعي
al-Suyūṭī, Abū al-Faḍl ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Bakr b. Muḥammad Ǧalāl al-Dīn al-Ḫuḍayrī al-Šāfiʻī
person.floruit: 9th / 15th centuryHe taught Šāfiʿī law in the mosque of Šayḫū and gave juridical consultations in which he handled various sciences.In 872/1467 al-Suyūṭī took up again the tradition of dictating (imlā) ḥadīṯ in the mosque of Ibn Ṭulūn, where his father had been a preacher. This method had been interrupted twenty years earlier. He obtained in 877/1472 the post of teacher of ḥadīṯ at the Šayḫūniyya. From 891/1486 he was also in charge of the Baybarsiyya ḫānqāh. He is the first to have introduced Muslim mystics into the field of the fatwā (in this, he was to be followed by other Šāfiʿī scholars of the 10th/16th century, such as Naǧm al-Dīn al-Ġayṭī and, above all, Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī
